notes: Volume (130 pp.): p. 2 title "Resultado elección ordinaria de diputados, domingo 7 de marzo de 1965"; pp. 3-5 national summary of party votes (V/M/T) by province, by Santiago district and by Ñuble agrupación, with NULOS Y BLANCOS and TOTAL; pp. 6-48 per-agrupación party tables by commune for 1a-13a (14a only its first page, p. 48); pp. 49-126 candidate tables by commune with provincial/agrupación total columns, starting with the last sheet of 8a (p. 49) and covering O'Higgins to Magallanes, except Malleco (absent); pp. 127-130 annex of national party totals for 1957, 1961 and 1965 (not transcribed). All figures are the T (total) columns. Valid votes, registered voters, elected candidates and seats are not printed anywhere in the volume, so valid/registered/seats are null and elected is null; lists sum exactly to cast minus nulos/blancos in every contest. Contests 1-8 (and Malleco, Chiloé) come from the summary because no candidate-level grouping table is in the volume for them. Santiago's 7a agrupación is split into its three districts (contest numbers 71, 72, 73). Llanquihue and Aysén form one grouping (same candidates); its figures are sums of the two printed provincial totals. Contest numbers after 16 are this transcription's ordinals (the candidate tables print no agrupación number). Lists are labelled by the letter printed before the party (A Vanguardia Nacional del Pueblo, B Conservador Unido, C Radical, D Comunista, E Acción Nacional, F Comandos Populares, G Democracia Agrario Laborista, H Democrático, I Demócrata Cristiano, J Liberal, K Socialista, L Democrático Nacional); in summary-based contests the label is the party name. Many pages are faint or overstruck; doubtful name readings carry [?], and illegible candidate figures are null with what could be read given in the contest notes. National: TOTAL DEL PAIS row, pp. 3-5; the Conservador national T prints as 121.?82 with a mark over the middle digit, read 121882 (= V 60757 + M 61125 and the sum of its province rows); nulos y blancos 70680, total 2353123.
